name: @penguinharness/dgm-rsi-toolkit
description: The DGM RSI Toolkit: the Darwin Gödel Machine (Sakana AI, 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22954), run the way the paper does — an archive holds the Target's harness variants, parents are drawn from it by score and diversity, a fresh Modifier session edits the parent's files into one candidate, every candidate is measured on the frozen Benchmark, and admitted variants join the archive for open-ended search. Self-contained: it creates the Target's harness slot, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.
